title: Structural basis for product specificities of MLL family methyltransferases.
authors: Li, Yanjing; Zhao, Lijie; Zhang, Yuebin; Wu, Ping; Xu, Ying; Mencius, Jun; Zheng, Yongxin; Wang, Xiaoman; Xu, Wancheng; Huang, Naizhe; Ye, Xianwen; Lei, Ming; Shi, Pan; Tian, Changlin; Peng, Chao; Li, Guohui; Liu, Zhijun; Quan, Shu; Chen, Yong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MLL家族甲基转移酶对组蛋白H3K4的甲基化产物特异性机制，虽涉及分子动力学模拟，但核心是蛋白-组蛋白底物互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA结合课题关联微弱。
abstract: Human mixed-lineage leukemia (MLL) family methyltransferases methylate histone H3 lysine 4 to different methylation states (me1/me2/me3) with distinct functional outputs, but the mechanism underlying the different product specificities of MLL proteins remains unclear. Here, we develop methodologies to quantitatively measure the methylation rate difference between mono-, di-, and tri-methylation steps and demonstrate that MLL proteins possess distinct product specificities in the context of the minimum MLL-RBBP5-ASH2L complex. Comparative structural analyses of MLL complexes by X-ray crystal structures, fluorine-19 nuclear magnetic resonance, and molecular dynamics simulations reveal that the dynamics of two conserved tyrosine residues at the "F/Y (phenylalanine/tyrosine) switch" positions fine-tune the product specificity. The variation in the intramolecular interaction between SET-N and SET-C affects the F/Y switch dynamics, thus determining the product specificities of MLL proteins. These results indicate a modified F/Y switch rule applicable for most SET domain methyltransferases and implicate the functional divergence of MLL proteins.
abstract_zh: 人混合谱系白血病（MLL）家族甲基转移酶将组蛋白H3赖氨酸4甲基化为不同的甲基化状态（me1/me2/me3），并具有不同的功能输出，但MLL蛋白不同产物特异性的潜在机制仍不清楚。在此，我们开发了定量测量单甲基化、二甲基化和三甲基化步骤之间甲基化速率差异的方法，并证明在最小MLL-RBBP5-ASH2L复合物背景下，MLL蛋白具有不同的产物特异性。通过X射线晶体结构、氟-19核磁共振和分子动力学模拟对MLL复合物进行的比较结构分析揭示，位于“F/Y（苯丙氨酸/酪氨酸）开关”位置的两个保守酪氨酸残基的动态精细调节产物特异性。SET-N和SET-C之间分子内相互作用的变异影响F/Y开关动态，从而决定MLL蛋白的产物特异性。这些结果表明，一个适用于大多数SET结构域甲基转移酶的修正F/Y开关规则，并暗示MLL蛋白的功能分化。
